CpsTooltipDirective.description:
CpsTooltipDirective provides advisory information for a target element.

Pressing Esc closes an open tooltip (WCAG 1.4.13) and nothing else, such as a dialog, menu or notification below it.
A menu, dialog or notification opened after the tooltip takes that Esc instead. Focus stays where it is; if it was
inside the tooltip, it goes back to the target. A tooltip stays open while its target has keyboard focus, and one
opened on hover also while the pointer is over the target or the tooltip.

props.description: Defines the input properties of the component.

values.name: cpsTooltip
values.description: Tooltip text or html to show.

values.name: tooltipOpenDelay
values.description: Delay to show the tooltip in milliseconds, it can be of type string or number.

values.name: tooltipCloseDelay
values.description: Delay to hide the tooltip in milliseconds, it can be of type string or number.

values.name: tooltipOpenOn
values.description: Determines whether the tooltip should open on hover, click or focus.

values.name: tooltipPosition
values.description: Position of the tooltip, it can be 'top', 'bottom', 'left' or 'right'.

values.name: tooltipPersistent
values.description: Determines whether the tooltip is persistent.

values.name: tooltipDisabled
values.description: When present, it specifies that the tooltip should be disabled.

values.name: tooltipMaxWidth
values.description: Max width of the tooltip of type number denoting pixels or string.

values.name: tooltipOffset
values.description: Tooltip offset, a number denoting pixels or a string.

types.description: Defines the custom types used by the component or service.

values.name: CpsTooltipPosition
values.description: CpsTooltipPosition is used to define the position of the tooltip.

values.name: CpsTooltipOpenOn
values.description: CpsTooltipOpenOn is used to define the event on which the tooltip should open.
